outcome: Cervical dilatation (anterior to posterior cervical rim measurement)
cohort: The study included 192 women at 24-42 weeks gestation who presented for assessment of labor to a tertiary inner city maternity service.
finding: Transabdominal and transperineal ultrasound is feasible in the labor room and generally offers greater accuracy than vaginal examinations for assessing labor progress, especially for fetal head position and caput succedaneum.
cross-section timing: As women presented for assessment of labor
